title: Conservative Policy Iteration For Zero-Sum POSGs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Occupancy-state reductions make dynamic programming possible for zero-sum partially observable stochastic games (zs-POSGs). Existing point-based solvers usually optimise a central value function. This restores Bellman recursion, but it requires point-based updates over high-dimensional occupancy spaces. We introduce an approximate policy-iteration algorithm for finite-horizon zs-POSGs. The method maintains one policy per player and updates both jointly along occupancy trajectories induced by conservative policy updates. Instead of approximating a full central value function, each update uses a single supporting hyperplane induced by the current joint policy. The algorithm alternates local policy improvements, conservative updates, and persistent exploration. Computation is therefore concentrated on occupancy regions where the current joint policy is exploitable. On finite-horizon zero-sum POSG benchmarks, the method is competitive at sma

translated_title: 面向零和部分可观测随机博弈的保守策略迭代
translated_abstract: 占用态约简使得动态规划可以应用于零和部分可观测随机博弈（zs-POSG）。现有的基于点的求解器通常优化一个中心价值函数，这虽然恢复了贝尔曼递归，但需要在高维占用空间上进行基于点的更新。我们为有限时域零和部分可观测随机博弈提出了一种近似策略迭代算法。该方法为每个玩家各维护一个策略，并在由保守策略更新所诱导的占用轨迹上对双方策略进行联合更新。每次更新不再近似完整的中心价值函数，而是仅使用由当前联合策略诱导的单个支撑超平面。算法交替进行局部策略改进、保守更新和持续探索，因此计算能够集中于当前联合策略可被利用的占用区域。在有限时域零和POSG基准测试上，该方法在较小规模上具有竞争力（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种针对有限时域零和部分可观测随机博弈的近似策略迭代算法，通过保守策略更新和基于当前联合策略的支撑超平面来替代对完整中心价值函数的近似，将计算集中于联合策略可被利用的占用区域。
en_tdlr: An approximate policy-iteration algorithm for finite-horizon zero-sum POSGs that replaces full central value function approximation with conservative policy updates and a single supporting hyperplane induced by the current joint policy, concentrating computation on occupancy regions where the joint policy is exploitable.
